apps.localizedDescription: P1ck4x3 is an experimental iOS customization toolbox powered by DarkSword. This beta has been tested primarily on iPhone 16 Pro running iOS 18.6.2 (22G100). Compatible with iOS 16.7.2, iOS 17.0–18.7.1 and iOS 26.0–26.0.1. WARNING: This app uses kernel-level and private SpringBoard capabilities. Test carefully.

versions.localizedDescription: P1ck4x3 public release. Includes Styles, Wallpapers, Cards, Passcode, Icon Studio, Dock, Island Aura and P1ck4x3 System. The IPA is unsigned and experimental.
